limitations: Research mechanics model; current team evidence stops at2024 season, not current2026 injuries/QB/rosters.
Regular-season only. Postseason multi-period overtime is not supported.
No play/player/route/tackle identities. Drive endpoints are sampled; within-drive physical paths are not generated.
Pace multiplier is a declared model sensitivity, not a fitted strategy or intervention effect.
Kickoff touchbacks use standard current35-yard spot; landing-zone20-yard exception, onside kicks, detailed timeout/penalty and within-drive decision strategy are not modeled.
Observed drive-state validation is not full-game prospective calibration evidence; do not rank this engine against M1 without a separate matched pregame evaluation.
Progression is sampled jointly within outcome and20-yard start band; rare unobserved next-possession field positions use an explicit no-return treatment.

scenario.interpretation: controlled duration sensitivity, not a forecast of a team's tactical choice
